reference_sql:
WITH line_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching lines
  SELECT order_id, quantity, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
)
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts) AS order_year,
       SUM(ls.quantity * ls.n_lines) AS units_stored,
       SUM(ls.quantity) AS units_unique,
       SUM(ls.quantity * (ls.n_lines - 1)) AS units_extra
FROM line_sets ls
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ls.order_id
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts)
alternatives:
WITH stored AS (  -- one row per year
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts) AS order_year, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units_stored
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts)
),
unique_lines AS (  -- one row per different line
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
  FROM order_lines
),
uniq AS (  -- one row per year
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts) AS order_year, SUM(u.quantity) AS units_unique
  FROM unique_lines u
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = u.order_id
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts)
)
SELECT s.order_year, s.units_stored, u.units_unique, s.units_stored - u.units_unique AS units_extra
FROM stored s
JOIN uniq u ON u.order_year = s.order_year

  FROM unique_lines u
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = u.order_id
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts)

SELECT s.order_year, s.units_stored, u.units_unique, s.units_stored - u.units_unique AS units_extra
FROM stored s
JOIN uniq u ON u.order_year = s.order_year
other_way.tradeoff: Two totals joined by year show each number on its own, but the grouped sets give all three from one pass over the lines.

solver.query:
WITH sets AS (SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_lines GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur)
SELECT year(o.order_ts) AS order_year,
       SUM(s.quantity * s.n) AS units_stored,
       SUM(s.quantity) AS units_unique,
       SUM(s.quantity * (s.n - 1)) AS units_extra
FROM sets s
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
GROUP BY year(o.order_ts)
